# Observed eBay.de search-result fixtures

Files in this directory are generated from saved real public eBay.de search pages with:

```bash
npm run capture:ebay-search -- \
  --html /path/to/saved-search-page.html \
  --url "https://www.ebay.de/sch/i.html?_nkw=headphones" \
  --id "observed-search-headphones" \
  --layout-class "desktop-list"
```

The capture tool intentionally keeps only the DOM that PriceLens search-card extraction
uses:

- eBay item link structure, with the real item id replaced by a deterministic synthetic id;
- visible title;
- visible price;
- visible shipping text when present;
- visible condition text when present.

It excludes seller/account areas, descriptions, tracking query parameters, images,
cookies and unrelated page markup. The original search URL is not retained; only its
SHA-256 digest is stored for provenance/deduplication.

## Review gate

Every generated fixture starts with:

```json
"reviewed": false
```

The generated `expectedCards` are only a starting point. A person must independently
compare them with the saved page or screenshots, correct any extractor mistakes, and
only then set `reviewed: true`.

Unreviewed fixtures do **not** count toward observed search-layout evidence or accuracy.

Run:

```bash
npm run evidence:ebay-search
```

Do not commit saved full eBay pages. Commit only the reduced JSON fixture generated by
the capture command.
